Curse of the Spawn Book Club, at it again!

After a booming first week, we're back to check out yet another 3 issues.

Unfortunately, the Spawn website has undergone a change and completely removed all mention of Curse of the Spawn, but worse still, all of those great high-res covers without the logo that I loved posting in these threads. So from here on out, Spawn Book Club will have whatever covers I can find. Shame.

But it'll take a lot more than that to stop us here!

Let us know in the comments below what you thought of this weeks issues! How was the art? What about the story? How many of you are reading this series for the first time?

Be sure to watch out for spoilers, and grab the digital comics down below if you so desire.

Alrighty then.

What we're reading this week:

Issue 4 - Damnation War

  • As Spawn races to rescue Madrid and Matthew, he is attacked by the demon chasing him, whom he eventually kills. Meanwhile, the Navkies attack the school. As Matthew runs to the auditorium, he is captured by Abel and taken to the tower. Madrid fights the Navkies with Siv and Flachette, and is saved by Spawn. After being expelled from the school, Madrid, Siv and Flechette race to the tower to save her son. Along the way, Bune attacks Spawn, only to be destroyed. At the tower, Spawn takes Matthew and warps him to his mother, and then kills Abaddon.

Issue 5 - Suture

  • John Mawbley is a serial killer certain he is cleansing society of its evil. When Gretchen Culver happens upon the carnage of Mawbley's crowd killing, she runs into traffic and is critically injured. She regains consciousness while being raped by the police and ambulance attendants, where she is beaten unconsciousness again. They deliver her to another serial killer for disposal. Meanwhile Sam and Twitch help their former police officers investigate still another murder case. When Twitch begins to question their career change, they land the missing persons case of Culver.

Issue 6 - Blood and Rain

  • Wayne Tannager seeks Sam & Twitch's help in locating his missing fiance, Gretchen Culver. Elsewhere, the police clear two more serial killer cases from their books when they find the killer sewn up by Suture's handiwork. Mawbley becomes Suture's next victim just as he intends to start a killing spree in a movie theatre. Meanwhile, Sam & Twitch trace Gretchen to an empty grave.

How we're reading it:

  • Singles
  • Curse of the Spawn: Sacrifice of the Soul - Book 1 Trade Paperback
  • Curse of the Spawn: Blood & Sutures - Book 2 Trade Paperback
  • Spawn .cbr
